registry_reuse.reason: Host Go staging/lock/authority internals, not package-like runtime capability; reuse existing ResolveLockFrom, lock validation, PackageLoader and authority wrappers. External registry search not applicable/authorized.

Host captured-process/quality diagnostics using existing SmokeSection.Notes/PUB015; no AILANG registry package can change this private CLI path or schema propagation. Reuse verified strutil.TruncateBytes for byte caps after UTF-8 normalization; do not change its policy.
Additive host CLI stderr observation after existing resolver/save; reuse existing resolved entries and warning conventions, no runtime package capability.
Tests/docs/evaluator evidence reuse existing local fixtures, Go test/build, bounded process helpers and repository gates; no package dependency introduced.

features.description: Assemble silent rewritten published manifest plus regenerated registry lock using validated previous metadata solely for existing D2 git carry-forward; prove exact module/asset bytes with real offline CLI
acceptance_criteria: Failing-first dependency-aware smoke and JSON tests reproduce actual copied relative-lock failure before implementation
Same-version local and registry module plus asset markers differ; direct real RunSmoke, real quality JSON and publish --dry-run select registry bytes with a regenerated registry-hash lock
Staged root assets remain staged; dependency source/assets share target; missing locked target cannot use newer cache fallback
Author manifest/lock snapshots remain unchanged, rewrite is idempotent for registry manifests and preserves existing whitespace cases; helper is silent and CLI wrapper retains progress output
Validated previous git pin works under confinement and PACKAGE_ROOT with no git/HTTP/HOME writes; missing/changed/tampered/malformed pins retain refusal, no copied path entries carried forward
Unavailable registry/provisioned/authority cases fail before child execution without lock fallback; pass focused tests, lint and boundaries

features.description: Preserve rErr and actual process/start/timeout causes before lossy truncation, selecting first meaningful diagnostic with UTF-8-safe8192-byte result and2048-byte failed Notes limits; keep PUB015/schema/NotRun semantics
acceptance_criteria: Stage rErr and nil result retain cause; actual failing process, start failure, empty output and timeout never become silent success or NotRun
Concrete plan selection prioritizes setup error/timeout then first Error:/panic:/fatal error:/FAIL:/PAR_ line over prefix noise and trace frames, with nonblank fallback and exit cause
First diagnostic preceding more than8KiB output survives; long non-ASCII and invalid UTF-8, oversized single line, truncation markers and timeout prefix fit byte caps
Human PUB015 and JSON existing smoke.notes agree on first cause; successful short output and no-run behavior unchanged; no new field/code/exit-policy or timeout weakening
Focused diagnostic, quality/no-run and existing smoke fail/pass/timeout/isolation tests plus lint pass

features.description: Warn on stderr after successful lock when root path intent was shadowed by actual non-path source; preserve exact resolver/lock/exit semantics
acceptance_criteria: Actual CLI same-version root path B shadowed by transitive registry B exits0 and warns; resolved source/version/hash/path/order match unchanged resolution
Warning names actual registry or git source accurately; direct path-selected and unrelated dependencies do not warn; conflicts still fail unchanged
Warning does not re-resolve, make network requests or write another lock; lock --check retains existing drift semantics, optional new check warning deferred
Focused warning/lock/path tests and lint pass; companion keeps pkg_commands.go under800 lines

features.description: Bank portable real offline CLI and authority/snapshot proof, focused/core/structure gates and user docs; document file-set divergence without tarball refactor and hand evidence to independent evaluator
acceptance_criteria: Portable real built CLI quality JSON/human and publish --dry-run plus direct real smoke use mock/preprovisioned registry; record reads and assert zero publish POST/upload/cascade/message calls and unchanged author inputs
Current authority boundary, D2/hash and snapshot/malformed/missing-target controls pass with no new HTTP/git/HOME authority path

make test-changed, lint, boundaries, home-isolation, file-sizes, changelog and fmt checks pass; no full local make test, policy thresholds/timeouts unchanged; exact PR CI supplies broad Linux/Windows gate
Windows uses portable paths/os.DevNull/bounded Go helpers and shared binary build; no shell-only fixtures or exact OS-error string assertions
Package-publishing guide and correctly headed unreleased fragment describe behavior and remedies; current file-set divergence documented without broad tarball refactor
Evidence and commits handed off to independent sprint-evaluator without executor score; no release/live publication claim
